title: fix(core, plugin-security, lint)!: a permission set's own field-mask row binds its own holders over that set's View All vote

_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbSUQWB2j9eHYsRcrCiq1X1C)_

domain:server#5 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jVPGBoi3MCGoKbW1Hv

Part of #33828

This PR lands the View All half of the card, as the maintainer ruled it. The Modify All half (whether a Modify All set's own row binds the same way) stays open on the card under the seat's ruling, so the card stays open when this merges.

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: semantic
Skills-docs: none — `skills/**` teaches no super-user field vote: its View All text covers rows and posture only (`objectstack-data/rules/security.md`, `relationships.md`), so no page states the rule this note amends.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:权限集自己写的字段行 `readable: false`,现在压过同一个权限集的"查看全部"(View All)字段投票,只靠这个权限集的人读不到该字段。数据接口和 `/auth/me/permissions` 答案一致。ADR-0066 D2 ⑧ 追加一条 2026-11-15 的注,只改 View All;"修改全部"(Modify All)保持现状,等裁决,所以本 PR 只是卡片的一半(Part of)。
- 为什么改:维护者在 #33828 裁定 A(平台修):同一权限集既给 View All 又显式隐藏某字段时,隐藏要生效。此前按 2026-11-02 的注,这一行对该权限集的持有人不起作用。
- 风险与回滚:对"同一权限集 View All + 自己的 `readable: false` 行"的持有人,该字段从可读变为隐藏(BREAKING,语义变化,changeset 按 minor 发)。升级指南新增一条目,告诉管理员怎么找出这种组合、该删行还是保留。平台自带的默认权限集没有这种组合。另一个权限集的 View All / Modify All 照旧让字段可读,平台管理员场景不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:① `packages/core/src/security/effective-object-permissions.ts` 的 `superuserFieldVote` 与 `declaresOwnReadMask`(规则本体);② `docs/adr/0066-unified-authorization-model.md` ⑧ 下新增的 2026-11-15 注(受管文本);③ `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.permission-own-field-mask-binds-over-own-view-all.ts`(随包发布的升级指南条目,写给管理员看的话)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/core build && pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security exec vitest run src/fls-own-field-mask-33828.test.ts`,预期 24 项全过(两个合并入口各 8 项、一致性 7 项、行级 1 项)。
- 需要你做的:审阅 ADR-0066 D2 ⑧ 新增的 2026-11-15 注(受管文本),同意后由席位安排落地。

## What changes

**The rule (ADR-0066 D2 ⑧, note of 2026-11-15).** A permission set that holds View All on an object, and not Modify All, casts no read vote on a field its own `fields` row declares `readable: false`. That row is the set's whole say on the field. "Explicit" is literal: an omitted `readable` parses to `true` and is never a mask.

**One function, asked per field.** `superuserFieldVote(sets, objectName, fieldName?)` in `packages/core/src/security/effective-object-permissions.ts` answers the per-field vote; `declaresOwnReadMask` reads the set's own row. Both field merges ask it with the field's name: `PermissionEvaluator.getFieldPermissions` (every data door) and `buildEffectiveFieldPermissions` (the `fields` slot of `/auth/me/permissions`). Without a field name the function answers object-wide, as before; the one caller that asks that way (`conditionedFieldEntries`, for the Modify All reading the access explanation shows) is unchanged.

**Not moved.** Another set's View All or Modify All on the object still makes the field readable (and, under Modify All, editable) for a caller who holds both sets, which is the case ruling of record 6573563853 fixed. A View All set still votes on every field it does not mask itself. View All never granted an edit, so an edit lock beside it binds as before. **Modify All is unchanged, pending a ruling**: a set holding `modifyAllRecords` votes on every field, its own rows included. The row-level bypass is untouched.

**One case said aloud.** A holder of the masked View All set who also holds a plain set that grants the object and names no field does not read the field. Only a read vote restores it: another set's own `readable: true` row, or its View All or Modify All on the object. The changeset and `authorization.mdx` say so in those words.

**Lint.** `security-superuser-field-mask-inert` reports only a row its own set's Modify All unbinds, and its message, hint, user sentence (eleven locales) and `os explain` entry name Modify All alone. The finding's `userTextParams` drop `bypass`, since one bypass is reported. `security-controlled-by-parent-master-reference-hidden` is skipped only beside Modify All, so it now speaks beside View All. The roll-up source rules (`validate-rollup-source-visibility.ts`) read a View All set's own mask as hiding the field and tell a View All parent the plain remedy. Rule ids are unchanged.

**ADR-0066.** One blockquote note appended under ⑧, after the 2026-11-02 note and before ⑨. It quotes the ruling as the card states it, covers View All only, says Modify All is unchanged pending a ruling, and replaces the 2026-11-02 sentence "a set can no longer withhold a field from its own View All / Modify All holders" for View All only. The earlier notes and the status line are untouched.

**Declared kind and upgrade guide (claim amendment 2, after contract review 6900701652).** The kind is `semantic`: what an author already writes, a `readable: false` row in a set that holds View All on the object, changes meaning for that set's holders. The changeset grades `@objectstack/core` and `@objectstack/plugin-security` `minor`, and lint and spec `patch`. `Clause-②` is `yes`, because the exported `superuserFieldVote` gains an optional third parameter and reads the `fields` of the sets it is given; called with two arguments it answers as before. The ADR-0087 disposition is `registered permission-own-field-mask-binds-over-own-view-all`: one semantic entry under `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/`, which ships in the upgrade guide. It carries no mechanical conversion, because deleting the row and keeping it are both access decisions that only the author can make. It tells an administrator how to find the pair and what to decide.

**Docs and comments (claim amendment 6895411337).** Two sentences in `content/docs/permissions/authorization.mdx` and `permissions-matrix.mdx` state the own-row exception. The doc comment above `FieldPermissionSchema` (`packages/spec/src/security/permission.zod.ts`) states it too; no `.describe()` text, schema or generated artifact changes (`check:docs`, `check:generated` and `check:api-surface` are green with no regeneration). One fixture comment in `explain-principal-person.test.ts` no longer says the pair cannot withhold a field.

## Tests

New pins live in files of their own; the shared files keep only the existing pins the note flips, edited in place.

- `packages/core/src/security/superuser-field-vote-33828.test.ts` (6): the row binds beside View All, by the object entry and by the wildcard; the set's View All still votes on fields it does not mask; reverse pin for another set's View All or Modify All; Modify All unchanged; edit lock and "explicit is literal"; `superuserFieldVote` per field and object-wide.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/fls-own-field-mask-33828.test.ts` (24): the same eight readings taken from each merge (`getFieldPermissions`, `/auth/me/permissions`), one `describe` per merge; seven parity pairs; the row-level bypass still held.
- `packages/lint/src/validate-security-posture-own-field-mask-33828.test.ts` (6) and `validate-rollup-source-visibility-own-field-mask-33828.test.ts` (4): View All beside the set's own mask is not reported, on a parsed set, through the wildcard and under a shadowed wildcard; both bits on one entry is reported; the finding names Modify All alone and its `userTextParams`; the hidden master reference is reported beside View All; the roll-up rules on parent and child.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/fls-own-field-mask-33828.dogfood.test.ts` (5), the door-level pin: on a booted showcase, two sets authored through the metadata door and two signed-up members. A holder of the pair alone is told by `/auth/me/permissions` that the hidden fields are unreadable, and the list door serves the rows without them. The control member also holds a second set with View All on the object and no field row: both doors serve the fields, and none is editable.
- Flipped in place: `validate-security-posture.test.ts` (the inert-rule cases that used View All, the master-reference control, one reachability fixture), `finding-user-text.test.ts` (the three sentences and their params), `validate-rollup-source-visibility.test.ts` (the View All cases and one inline snapshot).

**Ablations.** Twelve, each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on the committed fix, restored to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty. Where the subject resolves through `@objectstack/core`'s `dist/` (plugin-security, dogfood), core was rebuilt for the mutated and the restored leg and `scripts/ablation-dist-preflight.mjs` read the marker present, then `--absent`. Counts are red tests under the mutation; every restored run was green. Rows 1 to 11 were read on head `0245cb6d7`; the source they mutate is byte-identical on this head. Row 12 was read on this head.

| # | Rule put back | Red under the mutation |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | the set's own row is never read | core 3, plugin-security 8 |
| 2 | `getFieldPermissions` asks the vote object-wide | plugin-security 7 (its four readings and three parity pairs; the `/auth/me/permissions` readings stayed green) |
| 3 | the row-blind merge asks the vote object-wide | core 2, plugin-security 7 (the mirror of 2) |
| 4 | the set's own row also cancels another set's vote | core 1, plugin-security 4 (the reverse pins) |
| 5 | the own-row rule applied to Modify All too | core 2, plugin-security 2 |
| 6 | an omitted `readable` read as a mask | core 1 |
| 7 | the inert rule gated on View All again | lint 6 (three in the new file, three flipped pins) |
| 8 | the master-reference rule skipped beside View All | lint 1 |
| 9 | the roll-up rule reads View All as unbinding the mask | lint 2 |
| 10 | the roll-up hint says View All must go first | lint 1 |
| 11 | the row-level bypass consults the field rows | core 2, plugin-security 3 |
| 12 | the set's own row is never read, asked at the doors | dogfood 2 (the holder at `/auth/me/permissions` and at the list door; the premise and the two controls stayed green), core 3 |

A first attempt at mutation 1 was void: its build never got a turn on the shared verify lock, so nothing was measured. It was stopped, the file was restored to the HEAD blob, and the series ran afterwards in one hold of the lock (`VERDICT command-exit 0`).

**Red first.** Before the fix, with the closure built on the unfixed source, the new unit pins read core 3 red and plugin-security 8 red.

## Acceptance notes

- **Modify All.** Whether a Modify All set's own row should bind the same way is not decided here. The amendment says so, the pins hold today's behaviour, and the card stays open for that half.
- **Declarations.** `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)` and `Metadata-protocol: semantic` are the lines of claim amendment 2. A field a holder was served is now withheld, so the changeset carries the BREAKING banner and its ADR-0087 marker, and the full dogfood battery is owed on the final head (see Verification).
- **ADR-0087.** `registered permission-own-field-mask-binds-over-own-view-all`. `check-adr-0087-registration` reads the entry as new in this diff.
- **`userTextParams.bypass`.** Dropped from this one rule's finding. The sentence is rendered by the producer's own catalog, so no consumer reads the key apart from that catalog.
- **`FieldPermissionSchema.when` description.** Not edited. Its sentence about the super-user vote speaks of a co-held set that says nothing about the field, which still holds.
- **`content/docs/permissions/field-level-security.mdx`.** Not in this diff. Its sentence that a mask holds unless another set unmasks it does not name the own-set Modify All case; that line belongs with the Modify All ruling.
- **Local scope of the dependents run.** The dependents were run in full on head `0245cb6d7` (list under Verification). This round changes no source of core, plugin-security or lint, so on this head the local runs are the four touched packages, dogfood's typecheck, the door pin, scenarios, and the battery. `@objectstack/core` has 62 direct dependents and `@objectstack/lint` has 12, and beyond the listed ones they were not run locally. The selection was a `git grep` of the symbols and rule ids this diff moves, whose positive control is that it hits the packages that were run. It is blind to a test that reaches them without naming them. CI's Test Core runs every package on this head.
- **Base.** `origin/main` was merged at `86350e125` before the readings of this head.
- **Overlap.** `git merge-tree --write-tree` of this head exits 0 against `origin/main` and against the head of every open PR that touches a path of this diff or one of its two new directories: #34132 (it edits `packages/lint/src/rule-explanations.ts` in an unrelated entry and adds a semantic entry of its own), and #34129, #34089, #34078 and #34001 (each adds a semantic entry under another file name). The file lists of the 94 other open PRs were read; no other PR touches a file of this diff.
